# Jodit 4.15.14

Official https://github.com/xdan/jodit (MIT). Locked npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/jodit/v/4.15.14. Published 2026-09-24.

Self-hosted, unmodified ES5 UMD minified JS/CSS and LICENSE.txt from the npm tarball. SOURCE.json records origin, npm SHA512 integrity and SHA256 checksums. The tarball was verified before extraction. No CDN, remote source-editor library or upload endpoint is enabled.
